scope: Editor resource simulation in Online and Offline entry configurations; no native offline-bundle/HTTP/IL2CPP/device validation
startupDownloadUIProbe: Synthetic native UI input 25MiB/100MiB, not HTTP download acceptance
clientFlow: First arrival Story -> island camp hall -> tower defense -> island camp hall
businessFlow: First arrival Story -> island camp/profile/tasks -> expedition preparation -> tower defense -> island camp
expeditionSeedPolicy: Fresh local seed per expedition; accepted plan retained for resource retry; in-battle restart retains seed
rewardPolicy: Camp reward level captured at departure, including pending save retries
pauseValidation: Unity SendMessage invokes real focus/pause callbacks with nested manual/return pauses; not OS or device event acceptance
